description: List APPROVED regulatory compliance policies — rules AI-extracted from a regulation (for example EU Green Bonds, CSRD/ESRS) and approved by a dVeracity admin. This is the regulation-derived corpus; the Open Footprint sector guardrails from ofp_policies cite no regulation by design. Requires the VaaS plan or higher (VaaS, API or Enterprise); an Explorer account gets a 403 naming requiredTier, not data. Requires the compliance:read scope — a connector authorised before that scope existed must be re-authorised. Returns name, framework, domain, effective dates, the source regulation document, rule count and approval time per policy. Drafts and rejected policies are never returned. An empty list is a real answer (published:false with a reason): treat it as "none published", never as "no obligations exist", and do not invent rules to fill the gap.
name: compliance_policies
title: compliance_policies
